_note: Analytics and search-console integrations, edited in the CMS (Integrations). Leave a value empty to switch it off.
_googleSiteVerificationNote: Google Search Console → Add property → HTML tag method: paste only the content value, e.g. abc123XYZ.
_ga4MeasurementIdNote: Google Analytics 4 → Admin → Data streams → Measurement ID, e.g. G-XXXXXXXXXX.
_gtmContainerIdNote: Google Tag Manager container ID, e.g. GTM-XXXXXXX. Use GTM or GA4, not both for the same tag.
_bingSiteVerificationNote: Bing Webmaster Tools → HTML meta tag method: paste only the content value.
_clarityProjectIdNote: Microsoft Clarity → Settings → Overview → Project ID.
